correctness.rationale: Represent M_{2n} as twisted n-column two-rail ladder. For n≥4 all four-cycles are the n canonical rung/horizontal faces. Every perfect matching with at least one rung splits into even-length rung-free runs tiled uniquely by horizontal pairs, corresponding bijectively to an independent set of the cyclic n-edge index graph. The only rung-free matchings alternate along the 2n boundary; for even n they are the two maximal alternating independent sets, for odd n they are two extra frozen matchings with no completed square. Four-cycle switches precisely insert or delete a legal independent-set coordinate. Deleting S\T then adding T\S proves switch distance |S△T|; maximal distance 2⌊n/2⌋. Independence-set enumeration gives Lucas L_n vertices and nF_(n−1) edges. Independently built exact 2n-vertex graph, brute-enumerated all perfect matchings and four-cycles for n=4..10, found components [Λ_n] if even and [1,1,Λ_n] if odd, and reproduced edge counts. The all-n theorem uses the forced tiling proof, not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: Only 4-cycle switches; n=3 exceptional K3,3 excluded and longer alternating-cycle moves not covered.
